svg.title: C4 style container and technology boundaries for IDEA Core v0
svg.desc: An engineer uses either a browser or the IDEA Desktop. A separate Workspace process manages local engineering files and tools. Protected business commands go to the IDEA Server. The Server authorizes the operation and selects the configured Core v0 location. Large file bytes then flow directly between Workspace and one Artifact Gateway and Vault. A deferred second location shows the future multi-vault seam. The Gateway returns transfer evidence but cannot publish a Generation.
